body: The new Add Event overlay uses a plain `<button>` without `type="button"`. In HTML, the default type is `submit`, which can cause unexpected form submission if this calendar is ever rendered inside a `<form>` (or if the surrounding structure changes). Set `type="button"` explicitly on this new button.

`CalendarQuickCreateDialog` imports client-only modules (`@/components/ui/dialog`, `JournalCreateForm`) but the file is missing the `'use client'` directive. In Next.js App Router this will be treated as a Server Component and should fail to compile (server components cannot import client components). Add `'use client'` at the top of this file (or refactor so it no longer imports client-only modules).

With the introduction of `week`/`day` view modes (see new imports and `CalendarViewMode` usage), the sessionStorage restore logic earlier in this file still only accepts `'month' | 'agenda' | 'list'`. That means `week`/`day` can be saved but won’t be restored on reload. Update the restore validation to include the new modes (or validate against the toggle’s option list).

The week-cell "Add" button’s accessible name is just "Add", which is ambiguous in a 7-column grid (screen readers will encounter multiple identical buttons). Provide a more specific label (e.g. via `aria-label` including the date) so each button is uniquely descriptive.

body:
The "date-only" detection via `if "T" not in end_date` can misclassify valid ISO-like datetimes that include a time but use a space separator (which `datetime.fromisoformat()` accepts), widening the filter to end-of-day unexpectedly. Since the controller now accepts arbitrary strings, this can lead to surprising query results for some clients. **Severity: medium** [![Fix This in Augment](https://public.augment-assets.com/code-review/fix-in-augment.svg "Fix This in Augment")](https://app.augmentcode.com/open-chat?mode=agent&prompt=%23%23%20Review%20Comment%20Fix%20Request%0A%0APlease%20help%20me%20address%20this%20specific%20review%20comment%20from%20PR%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fhjed%2Fpersonal-management-system%2Fpull%2F633%0A%0A%23%23%23%20Review%20Comment%3A%0A-%20%2A%2AGitHub%20Comment%20ID%2A%2A%3A%203104430828%0A%0A%23%23%23%20Steps%20to%20Follow%3A%0A%0A1.%20%2A%2ADetermine%20Github%20Branch%2A%2A%3A%20Use%20%60git%20branch%20--show-current%60%20to%20get%20the%20current%20branch%2C%20then%20fetch%20PR%20details%20from%20the%20Github%20API%20to%20determine%20the%20correct%20branch%20for%20this%20PR%0A2.%20%2A%2ABranch%20Verification%2A%2A%3A%20Ask%20the%20user%20to%20switch%20branches%20if%20they%20are%20not%20on%20the%20correct%20branch%0A3.%20%2A%2AFetch%20Comment%2A%2A%3A%20Fetch%20the%20review%20comment%20details%20from%20the%20GitHub%20API%20using%20the%20comment%20ID%20above%0A4.%20%2A%2AAddress%20Comment%2A%2A%3A%20Help%20me%20fix%20the%20issue%20described%20in%20the%20review%20comment%0A%0APlease%20start%20by%20checking%20the%20current%20branch%20and%20PR%20details.)
